0022600028.text: The Utah Jazz (1-7, 0-3 on the road) enter their ninth game of the 2026-27 season on a six-game losing streak and sit 15th in the West, five games back in the Northwest. The Dallas Mavericks (4-3, 2-2 at home) are 9th in the West and two games back in the Southwest, coming off a loss. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Max Christie (hip), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2 and have not met yet this season, and the Jazz's last meeting was a 138-120 loss in Dallas on January 17.
